entries.name: --si-sys-color-background-0
entries.description: The absolute bottom layer, the literal background of the application.

entries.name: --si-sys-color-background-1
entries.description: The primary surface layer where most UI components sit. E.g., cards, side panels, containers that rest above background-0

entries.name: --si-sys-color-background-2
entries.description: For elements that are placed above background-1, implying a higher visual elevation.

entries.name: --si-sys-color-background-3
entries.description: Used for temporary UI layers that sit above all base surfaces and partially cover the interface below. Is usually paired with drop-shadows. E.g., toast notification, popovers, dropdowns, modals.

entries.name: --si-sys-color-background-4
entries.description: Used to layer in any of the other bases, when a stronger distinction is needed, especially to highlight a container.
